children: Strategy, the company formerly known as MicroStrategy, purchased 950 Bitcoin between September 14 and September 20 for approximately $75.7 million. The average price came in at $79,670 per coin, inclusive of fees, pushing the firm's total stash to a jaw-dropping 846,000 BTC.
That figure means Strategy now controls more than 4% of Bitcoin's hard-capped 21 million supply.
Strategy funded the entire purchase from its existing USD cash reserves, which stood at $1.05 billion as of September 20. The company also maintains a broader USD reserve of $5.04 billion.

The firm's total cost basis across all 846,000 BTC sits at roughly $63.8 billion, with an average acquisition price of around $75,416 per coin. With Bitcoin trading near $85,000 at the time of the purchase, Strategy is sitting on unrealized gains of approximately $8.1 billion. The total market value of the holdings clocks in somewhere between $71.9 and $72 billion.
This was the company's first Bitcoin purchase in nearly three weeks. Michael Saylor previewed the move on X with the characteristically understated post: "A little more orange."

Alongside the Bitcoin buy, Strategy repurchased approximately 1.77 million shares of its variable-rate STRC preferred stock for around $174 million. The company also spent $57.4 million covering preferred dividends and debt interest payments during the same period.

Strategy wasn't the only public company adding Bitcoin to its balance sheet last week. Across the corporate landscape, publicly traded firms accumulated a net 2,254 BTC during the period, with Strategy's 950 BTC representing roughly 42% of that total.
The broader stablecoin market also showed signs of fresh capital entering the ecosystem, with total stablecoin supply increasing by $56.29 million over the same stretch.
Strategy has been accumulating Bitcoin since 2020 and rebranded from MicroStrategy to Strategy to better reflect its Bitcoin-centric mission.
The fact that Strategy paid an average of $79,670 per coin, well below the prevailing market price near $85,000, suggests the company was opportunistic about timing its entries during the week.

title: Strategy acquires 950 BTC worth $75.7M as corporate Bitcoin buying trend accelerates
